data.additional_information:
Work on research and development of airborne power electronics systems for unmanned platforms including power conversion, protection, thermal behavior, and power distribution architectures. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

Research efficient DC-DC converter topologies for high-density airborne electronics systems. 
Study hot-swap battery architectures and seamless power transition mechanisms. 
Analyze switching losses, thermal behavior, and efficiency tradeoffs in power systems. 
Evaluate MOSFETs, gate drivers, PMICs, and protection devices for drone applications. 
Assist in development of custom power distribution and regulation architectures. 
Investigate EMI generation paths and noise coupling in mixed-signal systems. 
Support power subsystem validation using oscilloscopes, analyzers, and thermal tools. 
Study fault scenarios including short-circuit, reverse polarity, and overcurrent events. 
Benchmark aerospace and industrial-grade power electronics solutions and components. 
Prepare technical reports, validation observations, and subsystem documentation. 

Skills Required 

Strong understanding of analog and power electronics fundamentals. 
Basic knowledge of synchronous buck, boost, and buck-boost converters. 
Familiarity with MOSFET operation, switching behavior, and gate driving concepts. 
Understanding of PCB power routing, grounding, and decoupling principles. 
Ability to use oscilloscopes and debug basic power electronics circuits. 
Understanding of voltage ripple, transient response, and efficiency measurements. 

PREFERRED SKILLS 
Familiarity with LTSpice, PLECS, or equivalent simulation tools. 
Exposure to EMI/EMC concepts in switching power systems. 
Understanding of thermal analysis and heat dissipation techniques. 
Exposure to battery-powered embedded or robotics systems.
data.additional_details:
Please find below the additional important details regarding our Company Clauses & Policies:

1.NDA – Non-Disclosure Agreement
Candidates must not disclose or share any confidential information related to their job role, projects, company operations, or work responsibilities with any external party. This clause will remain applicable for a lifetime.
2.NCC – Non-Compete Clause
Upon joining the company, when you decide to leave the organization in the future, you will not be eligible to join any direct competitor of the company for a period of 3 years post the last working day.
3.Minimum Service Agreement – 2 Years
Candidates from any branch having less than 2 Years of Experience are required to sign a mandatory 2-year Minimum Service Agreement. However, Candidates with more than 2 years of prior experience are exempted from the Minimum Service Agreement. Additionally breach of this agreement will result in a financial penalty of 40% of the CTC.
